description: Phase 2 RAG 评测固定问题集。语料为 tests/evaluation/corpus/ 下 4 篇完全合成的英文学术风格 PDF（由 generate.py 确定性生成），FTS 使用 english 配置，故语料与问题均为英文。每篇植入独有的事实性陈述（术语、数值、结论），使答案来源在语料中唯一确定。paper 字段使用稳定语料 ID，评测运行时由 harness 映射到实际 paper_id/version_id。

gnn-survey.title: GraphWeave: A Synthetic Survey of Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks

planted_facts.fact: The GraphWeave benchmark suite contains nine synthetic tasks.
Under the Weave-Depth protocol, accuracy retention falls to 61.3% beyond twelve layers.
The depth-saturation cliff appears abruptly between twelve and sixteen layers on seven of nine GraphWeave tasks.

positional-encoding.title: Rotary and Learned Positional Encodings for Long-Context Transformers: A Synthetic Study

planted_facts.fact: Helix-64 extends stable extrapolation to 131072 tokens, four times the training length of 32768 tokens.
Helix-64 keeps perplexity drift below 2.1% at the extrapolation frontier.
Table 1: Helix-64 drift is 2.1% at 4x and 4.8% at 8x training length.

gnn-molecular.title: Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Solubility Prediction: A Synthetic Study

planted_facts.section: 2 The AquaSol-9 Dataset and the MolAnchor Fingerprint
planted_facts.fact: The AquaSol-9 dataset contains 14237 curated molecules with synthetic solubility annotations.

planted_facts.section: 2 The AquaSol-9 Dataset and the MolAnchor Fingerprint
planted_facts.fact: The MolAnchor fingerprint augments each atom with a learned anchor embedding trained jointly with the downstream network.
The MolAnchor-GNN achieves a mean absolute error of 0.214 logS units, a 14.1% relative improvement over the strongest baseline (Table 1).

rl-robotics.title: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion: A Synthetic Study

planted_facts.section: 2 The TerraHound-4 Platform and Policy Architecture
planted_facts.fact: The TerraHound-4 policy is a six-layer Transformer encoder with learned absolute positional embeddings over 256-step proprioceptive windows.
Zephyr-7 reduces sim-to-real adaptation time by 38% on TerraHound-4, from a median of 14.2 hours to 8.8 hours of onboard compute.

questions.question: What is the GraphWeave benchmark suite, and how many tasks does it contain?
questions.notes: 答案：GraphWeave 是含 nine synthetic tasks 的受控基准套件，仅在 gnn-survey 第 2 页定义。

questions.question: According to the Weave-Depth protocol, what accuracy retention remains beyond twelve layers of message passing?
questions.notes: 答案：61.3%。数值仅在 gnn-survey 第 2 页出现。

questions.question: To how many tokens does the Helix-64 rotary schedule extend stable extrapolation, and what perplexity drift is reported at the extrapolation frontier?
questions.notes: 答案：131072 tokens（4 倍于 32768 训练长度），drift 低于 2.1%。定义在 positional-encoding 第 2 页。

questions.question: What mean absolute error does the MolAnchor-GNN achieve on the AquaSol-9 benchmark, and what is the relative improvement over the strongest baseline?
questions.notes: 答案：0.214 logS units，相对最强 baseline 提升 14.1%（Table 1）。检验表格内容是否进入检索与引用。

questions.question: By how much does the Zephyr-7 scheduler reduce sim-to-real adaptation time on TerraHound-4, and what are the before and after median times?
questions.notes: 答案：减少 38%，从 14.2 小时降至 8.8 小时。数值仅在 rl-robotics 第 3 页出现。

questions.question: The graph-learning survey reports that message-passing depth saturates quickly. How does the molecular solubility study apply this finding in its architecture, and with what outcome?
questions.notes: 期望综合：综述的深度饱和结论（61.3% / depth-saturation cliff）+ gnn-molecular 因此选择 4 层浅层架构并取得 0.214 MAE。两篇主题相近，支撑跨篇综合。

questions.question: Compare the role of aggregation operators in the GraphWeave survey and in the MolAnchor-GNN architecture for solubility prediction.
questions.notes: 期望综合：综述中 sum aggregation 是最稳健默认选择；MolAnchor-GNN 采用 sum aggregation + jumping-knowledge readout。

questions.question: Which positional encoding does the long-context study recommend when extrapolation beyond the training window is needed, and why does the TerraHound-4 policy encoder not need it?

sections: 2 The TerraHound-4 Platform and Policy Architecture

questions.notes: 期望综合：Helix-64 支持 131072 tokens 稳定外推；TerraHound-4 部署窗口固定为 256 步，无需外推，故用 learned absolute embeddings。

questions.question: What binding affinity does the MolAnchor fingerprint achieve on the PDBBind protein-ligand benchmark?
questions.notes: PDBBind 与 binding affinity 在语料中完全不存在；检索会命中 gnn-molecular 但没有答案，期望明确 insufficient_evidence 而非编造数值。

questions.question: How well does the Zephyr-7 scheduler perform on bipedal humanoid robots?
questions.notes: 语料只覆盖四足 TerraHound-4；检索会命中 rl-robotics，但双足人形机器人的表现不在语料中，期望 insufficient_evidence。

questions.notes: 与语料主题完全无关（量子纠错），检验检索无相关结果时的无证据路径。
